629:t_002:4.en:
$$チコ$$
(It seems things are still awkward between her and $$ノノ$$...)

629:t_002:5.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「But what a swarm! If the $$バスター軍団$$ hadn't fought that desperate defensive battle, there would've been even more!?」

629:t_002:6.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「If this many hit Earth and the colonies all at once, there'd be nothing we could do.」

629:t_002:7.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We'll stop them here, whatever it takes! All units, are you ready!?」

629:t_002:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「We finally freed the world from the Empire! I won't let these things do as they please!」

629:t_002:10.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If only the $$クアンタ$$'s modifications were complete, the situation would be different...」

629:t_002:11.en:
$$刹那$$
「Right now, I'll do what I can with the $$ダブルオーライザー$$. I'm counting on your support, $$ティエリア$$.」

629:t_002:12.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Understood. I'll learn as much as possible about the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$' properties during this battle.」

629:t_002:13.en:
$$シン$$
「Don't push yourself, $$刹那$$. Princess $$マリナ$$ was worried about you too.」

629:t_002:15.en:
$$フェルト$$
($$刹那$$... So Princess $$マリナ$$ really is...)

629:t_002:16.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「To all units. We believe the harm to pilots from $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ attacks is caused by $$脳量子波$$.」

629:t_002:17.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「To prevent $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ assimilation, withdraw once the mental damage exceeds a certain level.」

629:t_002:18.en:
$$赤木$$
「So it's a battle of willpower! I'm confident about that!」

629:t_002:23.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Irregularities detected in Ensign $$レド$$'s pulse and respiration. I judge his psychological state to be one of uncertainty or hesitation.」

629:t_002:24.en:
$$レド$$
「Even if that's true, right now I have no choice but to fight.」

629:t_002:25.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin interception. We will stop the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ advance in this sector.」

629:t_004:0.en:
$$クラン$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ show up at a time like this!?」

629:t_004:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「But if they destroy each other with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, that'll help us a little!」

629:t_004:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「It seems that's a vain hope...!」

629:t_004:3.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Our movement analysis indicates that the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ and $$バジュラ$$ are coordinating their attacks on us!」

629:t_004:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So the two live in symbiosis!?」

629:t_004:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「No...! If they're already this powerful and numerous, and they advance on Earth together...!」

629:t_004:7.en:
$$刹那$$
「I know! But stopping the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ comes first right now!」

629:t_005:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$アイモ$$... $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ are singing...」

629:t_005:1.en:
$$シェリル$$
($$バジュラ$$... Listen to our song...)

629:t_005:2.en:
$$ランカ$$
(We aren't your enemies. So please... stop now...)

629:t_005:3.en:
$$モニカ$$
「There's no change in the $$バジュラ$$.」

629:t_005:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Their song isn't reaching them...?」

629:t_005:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ are doing what they can too.」

629:t_005:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「They believe their song... their feelings will reach the $$バジュラ$$.」

629:t_006:0.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$. We're protecting the $$クォーター$$.」

629:t_006:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Protecting the mothership is an absolute tactical rule. I understand that as well.」

629:t_006:2.en:
$$レド$$
「That's not it... I want to protect their song.」

629:t_006:4.en:
$$レド$$
「I feel... that I only truly learned what a song was after coming to Earth.」

629:t_006:5.en:
$$レド$$
「It isn't just a sequence of sounds or vibrations in the air... I think it's life itself.」

629:t_006:7.en:
$$レド$$
「And I... don't intend to fight those $$バジュラ$$ if we can understand one another.」

629:t_006:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The $$人類銀河同盟$$ considers the $$バジュラ$$ a hostile species alongside the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

629:t_006:9.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm no longer a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$. And the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ aren't really enemies either.」

629:t_006:10.en:
$$レド$$
「That's why I'll protect their song! I want to help them stop us fighting someone we don't need to fight!」

629:t_006:11.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't want... to feel what I felt with the $$クジライカ$$ ever again...」

629:t_006:13.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Now this is a surprise... $$レド$$ himself trying to communicate with creatures called $$バアル$$.」

629:t_006:15.en:
$$クラン$$
「You don't need to explain! You've spoken for all of us!」

629:t_006:16.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I rather like that wonderfully romantic way of thinking.」

629:t_006:18.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. I am no longer under the Alliance's control either.」

629:t_006:19.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I will act according to the judgment of Ensign $$レド$$, the human being.」

629:t_006:21.en:
$$アル$$
「A partnership between human and machine... What a wonderful thing.」

629:t_006:22.en:
$$アル$$
「Above all, Ensign $$レド$$'s growth as a person never ceases to amaze me.」

629:t_006:23.en:
$$宗介$$
「For the record, I've reached the same decision as $$レド$$.」

629:t_006:24.en:
$$アル$$
「So have I. I cannot let anything spoil this rare duet by $$シェリル・ノーム$$ and $$ランカ・リー$$.」

629:t_006:26.en:
$$アル$$
「Their songs are pleasant even to an AI such as myself.」

629:t_006:27.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm glad I lent you the $$シェリル$$ discs from my collection.」

629:t_006:28.en:
$$シモン$$
「Lending you my $$ランカ$$ discs was worth it too!」

629:t_006:29.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do it! Let's protect $$ランカ$$ and the others' song!」

629:t_006:30.en:
$$木下$$
「Yes! The Galactic Fairy and the Superdimensional Cinderella are symbols of our hope!」

629:t_007:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$'s pulse and respiration have returned to normal. The cause is unknown.」

629:t_007:2.en:
$$レド$$
「I... know what I want to do now.」
